title: Pointwise product rule for the divergence: v·div G = Σ_i ∂_i(vG_i) − Dv(G)
statement: Let m ∈ ℕ and ℝⁿ = Euclid (m+1). Let e_i = EuclideanSpace.single i 1 (i ∈ Fin (m+1)) be the standard basis vectors, and write G_i(y) = (G y)_i for the coordinates of G. If v : ℝⁿ → ℝ and G : ℝⁿ → ℝⁿ are differentiable at the point x, then v(x)·trace DG(x) = Σ_i D(vG_i)(x)e_i − Dv(x)(G(x)).
lean_statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (v : Euclid (m + 1) → ℝ) (G : Euclid (m + 1) → Euclid (m + 1)) (x : Euclid (m + 1)), DifferentiableAt ℝ v x → DifferentiableAt ℝ G x → v x * LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid (m + 1)) (fderiv ℝ G x) = ∑ i, fderiv ℝ (fun y => v y * G y i) x (EuclideanSpace.single i 1) - fderiv ℝ v x (G x)
